snippet.title: Thalassomania - Free Demo Trailer | Co-op PS1 Horror on a Fishing Trawler
snippet.description:
Free demo out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3050090/Thalassomania?utm_source=yt

PS1-style co-op horror for 1-4 players. Keep an old fishing trawler afloat through a North Sea storm while something hunts you through the vents.

You and up to three friends crew the boat: haul in the catch, keep the engine running, pump out the flood... and listen. You'll hear it before you see it.

- Online co-op for 1-4 players (made for 2-4, solo is brutal)
- A run of up to 30 minutes (as many times as you want)
- Proximity voice chat, so everyone hears the panic

The demo is free for Steam Scream Fest. If you enjoy it, a wishlist really helps a solo dev.

Discord: https://discord.gg/b7pEpm8nHs

#Thalassomania #HorrorGame #IndieGame
